target_definition.unit_or_option_space: percent, assessed against the prior-quarter growth reference

graph_diagnosis.summary: The graph offers a coherent demand-to-segment-to-consolidated-revenue framework for semiconductor earnings monitoring.
weaknesses: Several segment observations were disclosed after the forecast cutoff.
The graph has limited evidence on segment mix and prior-quarter comparison.

search_factors.why_search: Consumer demand informs gaming GPU sales momentum.
Inventory corrections can delay GPU purchases and shipments.
Industry conditions provide the cross-segment demand baseline.
Data-center sales can offset weakness in consumer-facing segments.

checkpoints.mechanism: Weaker discretionary spending reduces demand for gaming hardware.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Retail-sales indicators and gaming-market commentary show sustained weakness.

checkpoints.mechanism: Channel inventory correction suppresses gaming revenue recognition.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Management identifies inventory digestion or lower gaming sell-through.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Channel inventories normalize with improving sell-through.

checkpoints.mechanism: A broad semiconductor downturn lowers the demand backdrop for consolidated sales.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Industry sales data and company demand commentary point in the same direction.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: NVIDIA-specific demand diverges materially from industry conditions.

checkpoints.mechanism: Data-center growth can partially offset weakness in gaming revenue.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Data-center revenue is measured on a comparable year-over-year basis.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Enterprise spending or cloud demand slows sharply.

checkpoints.mechanism: Gaming drag and data-center contribution together determine consolidated revenue growth.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare segment revenue contributions with consolidated growth and the preceding quarter.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Segment trends do not reconcile to consolidated revenue.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Weak consumer demand and inventory correction reduce gaming revenue, weighing on consolidated growth.
applicability_conditions: Gaming is material to consolidated revenue.
failure_conditions: Data-center growth is large enough to offset gaming weakness.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Industry weakness pressures revenue while resilient data-center demand provides an offset.
failure_conditions: Company-specific product demand diverges from the industry cycle.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Data-center expansion fully offsets gaming weakness.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare the dollar contribution of data-center growth with gaming revenue change.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The semiconductor downturn is mainly consumer-channel specific.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare gaming-channel trends with enterprise and data-center demand.

forecast_audit_questions: Do gaming inventory signals agree with consumer-demand evidence?
Is data-center growth large enough to offset the gaming drag?
Do segment contributions reconcile with consolidated revenue growth?
Are comparisons made using equivalent year-over-year periods?
